label: About
title: what i'm made of
lead: I speak the languages of engineering, technology, and human connection. Somewhere between them, I engineer empathy.

items.label: civil engineer
items.text: MS in Civil Engineering and real estate management. Designed hospitals and perinatal centers — structure, systems, and stakes that matter.

items.label: another education
items.text: An attempt at pedagogy and English philology — begun, not finished; still part of the wiring.

items.label: block-scheme mind
items.text: I think in flowcharts. First book at five: an encyclopedia of cybernetics. There I saw block schemes and understood: this is how I think.

items.label: speed
items.text: Very fast reading — an edge when dropping into any product or grant brief.

items.label: languages
items.text: Love of foreign languages and everything around them: tone, nuance, the keys to communication. Learned English, German, and Japanese, with Finnish and Spanish currently joining the mix.

items.label: people
items.text: Diversity — and the craft of finding the keys to communication across difference.

items.label: my values
items.text: being honest enough with yourself to know what you actually want, and brave enough to act on it

startupText: Seven years in startups — hired as CEO and CBDO across SaaS, deeptech, and EdTech. Now building my own projects. Vibe coding, product launch and business development.
